summary: Reproduced the DeepSeek MLA state-dict key transition in the checked-out implementation: registering kv_b_proj on attn_mha after forward causes sharded-state deduplication to retain only the attn_mha alias, which a fresh model does not expose. The loader now narrowly resolves that historical alias to the canonical fresh-model key.

tests.what_was_measured: Four CPU regressions covering the failing post-forward/fresh-model key mismatch, an already-present alias, an unrelated attn_mha key, and a missing canonical key.

The actual ShardedStateLoader._filter_subtensors implementation retains kv_b_proj.weight before alias registration and attn_mha.kv_b_proj.weight afterward; direct lookup in a fresh state dict raises KeyError.

gpu_execution.evidence: The assigned AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950 class) was visible through ROCm PyTorch, but the defect and regression are CPU-only state-dict naming behavior; no model inference was claimed.

remaining_limitations: DeepSeek-V2-Lite weights were not available, so the full Engine save/load reproduction and model-semantic validation were not run.
The deterministic tiny Llama serving fixture cannot qualify DeepSeek MLA architecture behavior and was therefore not substituted for the reported model.
No CUDA/GH200 reproduction was possible in the assigned ROCm gfx950 environment.
